result.summary: All T-BG tests written and green per file. Real per-file runs: scope_enforcement_out_of_band_test 43 passed; release/scope_break_glass_test 24 passed; mix/tasks/letflow_scope_enforcement_break_glass_test 12 passed; scope_enforcement_flip_authority_test 31 passed (14 + 17 new); docs/roles_on_flip_docs_test 25 passed (18 + 7 new); regressions unchanged and green: on_flip_guards 17, scope_enforcement_transitions 36, scope_enforcement_test 23, scope_enforcement_on_test 16, ci_backend_path_filter 18. mix format --check-formatted on all six touched/new test files: clean. GAPS: mix letflow.check.test NOT run (supervisor rule), so the dead-default-argument check is not machine-verified (no test helper uses a default argument; the one fixture function with defaults was avoided by design); only 5 mutants measured (below). R5 FOLLOW-UP (F1-F4) done: per-file runs docs 26, flip_authority 33, release 27, core 44, mix task 12, all passed; 12 mutants measured in memory. R10 update: F4 pins switched to option (b) (accepted limitation, positive pins + negative pins for last resort / sign-off / SQL snippet / weakened prohibition, each with a seeded offender); roles_on_flip_docs_test 26 passed, format clean. AUDITOR TIGHTENING (PR #2894): stamp_opener_scan_test.exs @set_config_files is now a minimal file=>names map (scope_enforcement.ex: lock_timeout only; letflow.managed_by_stamp: stamp.ex only), with synthetic negatives (1)-(4); 16 passed, format clean.
implementation_findings: Design inconsistency, not a code bug: design 6 (2b) allows ScopeBreakGlass only in the release module and Mix task, but design 10.3 (and the implementation) name it in the ScopeEnforcement moduledoc. The scan allows that one mention.
OptionParser keeps the last value of a repeated switch in the Mix task; not rejected (harmless, values validated by run/5). Pinned by a test.

CI gap: docs/migration/ is not in BACKEND_PATHS_RE, so a change confined to decision records does not trigger the backend job although roles_on_flip_docs_test now reads decision 0051. Test builds the path with Path.join to pass ci_backend_path_filter_test.
A fault log line with an invalid operator label is unreachable through the public API (invalid labels are refused first); operator_suffix/1 is exercised via refusal lines.
No implementation bug found in flip_out_of_band/3, ScopeBreakGlass or the Mix task.
result.for_test_design_validator: Re-apply reported mutants with test/specs scratch harness idea (in-memory Code.compile_string of a one-line change) and measure the unmeasured ones, notably MU-BG-6/7/8 (locks), MU-BG-22 (no lock_timeout), MU-BG-27b (timeout formula), MU-BG-11b (label suffix), MU-BG-12 (label rule).
